caption: The drawing depicts a textile or embroidery design on a light beige or off-white background. The composition is divided into three main vertical sections: the central section features a dense bouquet of flowers and leaves, predominantly in shades of brown, red, pink, and green. The flowers resemble roses, with various smaller blossoms interspersed among green and brown leaves. To the left and right of this floral arrangement, there are repeated, wavy horizontal green lines, each line interspersed with short, upright segments topped with small green dots, giving the appearance of stylized waves or rows of foliage. The left and right borders of the design are adorned with small, scattered floral or leaf motifs, similar in color to the central bouquet. The design is enclosed within a rectangular frame, and there is no background detail other than the plain surface.
title: Printed Textile
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
